newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aerospace considers spin-off.
newsitem.headline: China Aerospace considers spin-off.

text.p: China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd said on Monday that as part of a business review it was considering spinning-off part of its operations.
"The directors are reviewing the business activities and corporate structures of the company and its subsidiaries," the company said in a statement.

"This review includes...considering the possibilities of spinning-off part of the group's operations, the development and expansion of new and existing businesses, the acquisition or disposal of businesses and arrangements for alternative financing," China Aerospace added.
It said it had not yet decided whether to proceed with any of the plans.
China Aerospace shares rose HK$0.15 on Friday to close at HK$3.125 and rose HK$0.35 or 12.6 percent last week.
